shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls /workspace; echo "---app dir---"; find /workspace -maxdepth 4 -iname "app" -not -path "*/node_modules/*"; echo "---pages dir---"; find /workspace -maxdepth 4 -iname "pages" -not -path "*/node_modules/*"

echo "--- app dir tree ---"; find /workspace/app -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head -100; echo "--- next.config.ts ---"; cat /workspace/next.config.ts; echo "--- tsconfig ---"; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json

grep -r "authInterrupts" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---"; grep -rl "forbidden" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigation.js 2>/dev/null; echo "---navigation exports---"; grep -n "forbidden\|unauthorized" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigation.js | head -20; echo "---version---"; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

grep -rn "forbidden" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; grep -rln "forbidden.tsx\|FORBIDDEN_ROUTE\|forbidden-boundary\|'forbidden'" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/lib/ 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---find---"; find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist -iname "*forbidden*" | head -30
(npm run dev > /tmp/nextdev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -o /tmp/admin_out.html -w "HTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/admin; echo "---log tail---"; tail -40 /tmp/nextdev.log
grep -o "<h1[^<]*<\|403\|Forbidden\|restricted to administrators" /tmp/admin_out.html | sort -u; echo "---"; pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo done
git status --short; echo "---"; ls -la AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null
git diff tsconfig.json; echo "---package.json diff (pre-existing before my changes)---"; git diff package.json

cat /workspace/.gitignore 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; git checkout -- tsconfig.json; rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/AGENTS.md /workspace/CLAUDE.md /workspace/next-env.d.ts /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git status --short
